connector_scope: Each complete resulting artifact is constrained by its 320 MiB public directory plus ZIP packaging overhead. Its actual provider size/digest must be checked before connector reception; the 652195421-byte original is never passed to the capped connector.
part_publication: Same-filesystem relocation only after bound closed ECHILD; no third original-size copy.
runtime_required: Unchanged controller must observe the exact filesystem/devices, at least 8 GiB and 100000 free inodes, full original/private slices, bound ECHILD, relocation identity and actual closed storage. Static arithmetic does not bypass any reserve or make READY.
